steps.name: Environment: Detect/ensure JDK>=17, Maven>=3.8, jq/unzip; persist safe non-secret env
steps.description: Detect presence and versions of java and javac (require >=17), detect mvn (require >=3.8) or prepare to generate mvnw later. Install openjdk-17-jdk, maven, jq, unzip only when missing or version insufficient. Create an atomic /etc/profile.d/upstdc_env.sh that exports non-secret defaults (SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE=dev, SERVER_PORT=8080) and a FILE_STORAGE_PATH default referencing the authoritative workspace variable. Do NOT persist DB secrets. Validate tool availability afterward.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/uttar-pradesh-tourism-infrastructure-monitoring-system-217467-217482/upstdc_backend"
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
need_install=()
# Java/javac detection (robust): prefer javac -version, fallback to java -XshowSettings:properties -version
JAVA_OK=0
if command -v javac >/dev/null 2>&1; then JVER=$(javac -version 2>&1 || true); else JVER=""; fi
if [ -z "${JVER:-}" ] && command -v java >/dev/null 2>&1; then JVER=$(java -XshowSettings:properties -version 2>&1 | awk -F '"' '/java.version/ {print $2; exit}' || true); fi
# parse major.minor (handles 17.0.8, 20, 21-ea)
if [ -n "${JVER:-}" ]; then JMAJOR=$(printf '%s' "$JVER" | sed -E 's/^([0-9]+).*/\1/'); if [ "$JMAJOR" -ge 17 ]; then JAVA_OK=1; fi; fi
if [ $JAVA_OK -ne 1 ]; then need_install+=(openjdk-17-jdk); fi
# mvn detection and version check
MVN_OK=0
if command -v mvn >/dev/null 2>&1; then MVNV=$(mvn -v 2>/dev/null | awk '/Apache Maven/ {print $3; exit}' || true); fi
if [ -n "${MVNV:-}" ]; then MJR=$(printf '%s' "$MVNV" | cut -d. -f1); MMIN=$(printf '%s' "$MVNV" | cut -d. -f2 || echo 0); if [ "$MJR" -gt 3 ] || { [ "$MJR" -eq 3 ] && [ "$MMIN" -ge 8 ]; }; then MVN_OK=1; fi; fi
if [ $MVN_OK -ne 1 ]; then need_install+=(maven); fi
# ensure jq/unzip present
if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then need_install+=(jq); fi
if ! command -v unzip >/dev/null 2>&1; then need_install+=(unzip); fi
if [ ${#need_install[@]} -ne 0 ]; then sudo apt-get update -q && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends "${need_install[@]}" >/dev/null; fi
# re-validate
command -v java >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "java not found after attempted install" >&2; exit 2; }
command -v javac >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "javac not found; ensure JDK installed" >&2; exit 3; }
if command -v mvn >/dev/null 2>&1; then MVNV=$(mvn -v 2>/dev/null | awk '/Apache Maven/ {print $3; exit}' || true); else MVNV=""; fi
# create workspace dir
mkdir -p "$WS" "$WS/storage"
# write /etc/profile.d/upstdc_env.sh atomically without hardcoding WS into the profile expansion at runtime
PROFILE_TMP=$(mktemp)
cat > "$PROFILE_TMP" <<EOF
# upstdc_env - autogenerated; safe to re-run
export SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE="dev"
export SERVER_PORT="8080"
# default file storage (workspace-relative) if FILE_STORAGE_PATH not set
export FILE_STORAGE_PATH="
${FILE_STORAGE_PATH:-$WS/storage}
"
# NOTE: do NOT store DB credentials here; set DB_USER/DB_PASSWORD/DATABASE_URL via container env or secret manager
EOF
# idempotent install: only move into /etc/profile.d if sentinel missing
SENTINEL="# upstdc_env - autogenerated; safe to re-run"
if ! sudo grep -qF "$SENTINEL" /etc/profile.d/upstdc_env.sh 2>/dev/null; then sudo mv "$PROFILE_TMP" /etc/profile.d/upstdc_env.sh && sudo chmod 644 /etc/profile.d/upstdc_env.sh; else rm -f "$PROFILE_TMP"; fi
# final validations
java -version >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "java runtime missing" >&2; exit 4; }
javac -version >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "javac missing" >&2; exit 5; }
if command -v mvn >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "maven: $MVNV" >/dev/null; else echo "maven not available; deps step may attempt to generate mvnw" >/dev/null; fi

steps.name: Scaffolding: Create minimal Spring Boot Maven project (Java 17) with H2, Actuator, JUnit5 and .env.example
steps.description: If workspace contains pom.xml or .git, skip. Otherwise create a Maven Spring Boot project scaffold using spring-boot-starter-parent, configure maven-compiler-plugin for Java 17, include H2 (runtime), actuator (health,info) and starter-test, create application-dev.properties tailored to use FILE_STORAGE_PATH based on authoritative WS, create storage dir and a .env.example documenting runtime env variables.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/uttar-pradesh-tourism-infrastructure-monitoring-system-217467-217482/upstdc_backend"
cd "$WS"
[ -f pom.xml ] || [ -d .git ] && exit 0
mkdir -p src/main/java/com/example/upstdc src/main/resources src/test/java/com/example/upstdc
cat > pom.xml <<'POM'
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0">
  <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>
  <parent>
    <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
    <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-parent</artifactId>
    <version>3.1.4</version>
    <relativePath/> <!-- lookup parent from repository -->
  </parent>
  <groupId>com.example</groupId>
  <artifactId>upstdc-backend</artifactId>
  <version>0.0.1-SNAPSHOT</version>
  <properties>
    <java.version>17</java.version>
  </properties>
  <dependencies>
    <dependency><groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId><artifactId>spring-boot-starter-web</artifactId></dependency>
    <dependency><groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId><artifactId>spring-boot-starter-actuator</artifactId></dependency>
    <dependency><groupId>com.h2database</groupId><artifactId>h2</artifactId><scope>runtime</scope></dependency>
    <dependency><groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId><artifactId>spring-boot-starter-test</artifactId><scope>test</scope></dependency>
  </dependencies>
  <build>
    <plugins>
      <plugin>
        <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
        <artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId>
        <configuration>
          <release>17</release>
        </configuration>
      </plugin>
      <plugin>
        <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
        <artifactId>spring-boot-maven-plugin</artifactId>
      </plugin>
    </plugins>
  </build>
</project>
POM
cat > src/main/java/com/example/upstdc/UpstdcApplication.java <<'APP'
package com.example.upstdc;
import org.springframework.boot.SpringApplication;
import org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.SpringBootApplication;
@SpringBootApplication
public class UpstdcApplication { public static void main(String[] args){ SpringApplication.run(UpstdcApplication.class,args);} }
APP
# application-dev.properties - ensure actuator exposed and security disabled for dev so health is reachable
cat > src/main/resources/application-dev.properties <<PROPS
spring.datasource.url=jdbc:h2:mem:upstdc;DB_CLOSE_DELAY=-1
spring.datasource.driverClassName=org.h2.Driver
spring.datasource.username=sa
spring.datasource.password=
spring.h2.console.enabled=true
management.endpoints.web.exposure.include=health,info
management.endpoint.health.show-details=always
# disable security for dev profile to allow actuator probe (safe for local dev)
spring.security.enabled=false
server.port=
# server.port set at runtime via SERVER_PORT env or --server.port
file.storage.path=${FILE_STORAGE_PATH:${user.dir}/storage}
PROPS
mkdir -p "$WS/storage"
cat > src/test/java/com/example/upstdc/SimpleTest.java <<'TST'
package com.example.upstdc;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;
class SimpleTest { @Test void smoke(){ assertTrue(true); } }
TST
cat > .env.example <<'ENV'
# Development environment example
SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE=dev
SERVER_PORT=8080
# Optional DB vars (for headless dev we use in-memory H2 by default)
# DATABASE_URL=jdbc:postgresql://... 
# DB_USER=...
# DB_PASSWORD=...
ENV
# attempt to generate mvnw if mvn missing (best-effort, non-failing here)
if ! command -v mvn >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v bash >/dev/null 2>&1; then mvn -N io.takari:maven:wrapper -Dmaven=3.8.8 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi

steps.name: Dependencies/Build: Ensure mvnw or validate mvn, resolve dependencies (go-offline) or build package
steps.description: Prefer project mvnw if present. If system mvn is absent, attempt to generate mvnw non-interactively; if wrapper generation fails, fail fast with remediation. Validate mvn/mvnw is runnable and version >=3.8. Attempt dependency:go-offline to warm the local repo; if that fails, run -DskipTests package to produce the fat jar for validation.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/uttar-pradesh-tourism-infrastructure-monitoring-system-217467-217482/upstdc_backend"
cd "$WS"
# Prefer mvnw
if [ -x ./mvnw ]; then MVN_CMD=./mvnw; else
  if command -v mvn >/dev/null 2>&1; then MVN_CMD=$(command -v mvn); else
    # attempt to generate mvnw (requires network). Fail clearly if it doesn't work.
    if command -v bash >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      mvn -N io.takari:maven:wrapper -Dmaven=3.8.8 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "mvn not present and mvnw generation failed; install maven or ensure network for wrapper" >&2; exit 4; }
      MVN_CMD=./mvnw
    else
      echo "maven not available and cannot generate mvnw" >&2; exit 4
    fi
  fi
fi
# validate mvn runnable & version
"$MVN_CMD" -v >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "maven command not runnable: $MVN_CMD" >&2; exit 5; }
MVNV=$("$MVN_CMD" -v 2>/dev/null | awk '/Apache Maven/ {print $3; exit}' || true)
if [ -n "${MVNV}" ]; then MJR=$(printf '%s' "$MVNV" | cut -d. -f1); MMIN=$(printf '%s' "$MVNV" | cut -d. -f2 || echo 0); if [ "$MJR" -lt 3 ] || { [ "$MJR" -eq 3 ] && [ "$MMIN" -lt 8 ]; }; then echo "maven >=3.8 required (found $MVNV)" >&2; exit 6; fi; fi
# attempt go-offline, fallback to package
if ! "$MVN_CMD" -B -DskipTests dependency:go-offline >/dev/null 2>&1; then "$MVN_CMD" -B -DskipTests package >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'maven build failed' >&2; exit 7; }; fi

output_scripts.code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Workspace from container info
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/uttar-pradesh-tourism-infrastructure-monitoring-system-217467-217482/upstdc_backend"
cd "$WS"

# Prefer project mvnw if executable
if [ -x "./mvnw" ]; then
  MVN_CMD="./mvnw"
else
  # If system mvn exists use it
  if command -v mvn >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    MVN_CMD=$(command -v mvn)
  else
    # Attempt to generate mvnw non-interactively. This requires mvn available to run io.takari:maven:wrapper
    # If mvn not present we cannot generate wrapper; fail fast with remediation message.
    echo "maven (mvn) not found on PATH; cannot generate mvnw. Please install maven or provide a project mvnw wrapper." >&2
    exit 4
  fi
fi

# Validate maven command is runnable
if ! "$MVN_CMD" -v >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "maven command not runnable: $MVN_CMD" >&2
  exit 5
fi

# Extract version and ensure >= 3.8
MVNV=$("$MVN_CMD" -v 2>/dev/null | awk '/Apache Maven/ {print $3; exit}' || true)
if [ -z "${MVNV}" ]; then
  echo "Unable to determine Maven version from: $MVN_CMD" >&2
  exit 6
fi

MJR=$(printf '%s' "$MVNV" | cut -d. -f1)
MMIN=$(printf '%s' "$MVNV" | cut -d. -f2 || echo 0)
if [ "${MJR}" -lt 3 ] || { [ "${MJR}" -eq 3 ] && [ "${MMIN}" -lt 8 ]; }; then
  echo "maven >=3.8 required (found $MVNV). Remediation: install Maven 3.8+ or provide a project mvnw wrapper." >&2
  exit 6
fi

# Try warming local repo with dependency:go-offline; if it fails, run package to create fat jar
if "$MVN_CMD" -B -DskipTests dependency:go-offline >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "dependency:go-offline succeeded"
else
  echo "go-offline failed; attempting -DskipTests package to produce artifact"
  if "$MVN_CMD" -B -DskipTests package >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "package succeeded"
  else
    echo "maven build failed (go-offline and package both failed). Check network, repository settings, and build errors." >&2
    exit 7
  fi
fi

steps.name: Validation: Build, start app with explicit port and storage path, probe health, stop cleanly
steps.description: Build (if needed), find the Spring Boot fat jar (detect BOOT-INF), start it with deterministic env (SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE=dev, FILE_STORAGE_PATH pointing to WS/storage, SERVER_PORT default 8080), tail logs briefly to detect immediate failures, probe /actuator/health until UP with timeout, then gracefully stop the process. Provide logs on failure. This validates H2, actuator, file storage path and runtime start/stop. Note: container port mapping is external; ensure docker run uses -p 8080:8080 to expose the service if external access is required.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/uttar-pradesh-tourism-infrastructure-monitoring-system-217467-217482/upstdc_backend"
cd "$WS"
if [ -x ./mvnw ]; then MVN_CMD=./mvnw; else MVN_CMD=$(command -v mvn || true); fi
[ -n "${MVN_CMD:-}" ] || { echo 'mvn not available' >&2; exit 6; }
"$MVN_CMD" -B -DskipTests package >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'build failed' >&2; exit 6; }
# find fat jar by BOOT-INF
JAR=""
for j in target/*.jar; do [ -f "$j" ] || continue; if unzip -l "$j" 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'BOOT-INF'; then JAR="$j"; break; fi; done
if [ -z "$JAR" ]; then JAR=$(ls -1t target/*.jar 2>/dev/null | head -n1 || true); fi
[ -n "$JAR" ] || { echo 'jar not found in target/' >&2; exit 7; }
LOG=/tmp/upstdc_app.log
SERVER_PORT=${SERVER_PORT:-8080}
export FILE_STORAGE_PATH=${FILE_STORAGE_PATH:-$WS/storage}
export SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE=${SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE:-dev}
# start app
nohup java -jar "$JAR" --server.port=${SERVER_PORT} >"$LOG" 2>&1 &
APP_PID=$!
# give a short grace period to detect immediate failures
sleep 2
if ! kill -0 "$APP_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "app process died immediately; tail log:" >&2; tail -n 200 "$LOG" >&2 || true; exit 8; fi
trap 'kill -TERM "$APP_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; sleep 3; kill -KILL "$APP_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT INT TERM
# wait for health
TIMEOUT=60; SECS=0
while true; do
  if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then STATUS=$(curl -sS "http://127.0.0.1:${SERVER_PORT}/actuator/health" 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.status' 2>/dev/null || true); [ "$STATUS" = "UP" ] && break
  else
    RESP=$(curl -sS "http://127.0.0.1:${SERVER_PORT}/actuator/health" 2>/dev/null || true); echo "$RESP" | grep -q 'UP' && break
  fi
  sleep 1; SECS=$((SECS+1))
  if [ $SECS -ge $TIMEOUT ]; then echo "app did not report UP in ${TIMEOUT}s; tail log:" >&2; tail -n 400 "$LOG" >&2 || true; kill -TERM "$APP_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; exit 9; fi
done
# evidence
curl -sS "http://127.0.0.1:${SERVER_PORT}/actuator/health" || true
echo "APP_PID=$APP_PID"
# graceful shutdown
kill -TERM "$APP_PID" || true
for _ in {1..10}; do if ! kill -0 "$APP_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "process $APP_PID stopped"; break; fi; sleep 1; done
if kill -0 "$APP_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then kill -KILL "$APP_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi
trap - EXIT INT TERM
